notes: לִפְנֵי fuses to 'before' while מִפָּנָיו is split: there the ASV spends 'from' on the preposition and 'before' on the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 governs.
The object marker on the Jordan is unrepresented; 'over' belongs to the phrasal verb 'pass over' (rules 16, 44).
